decisions.reason: As the flagship transactional email service shown on the home page and aligned with the firm's cloud messaging direction, it likely meets aspirations and warrants continued investment rather than search for alternatives.
Document capture with its own page supports the firm's electronic document workflow strategy, and the firm has enough slack to carry it while its results remain uncertain.

Email-to-fax conversion builds on the established fax and messaging base with regulated-sector customers and costs little to maintain, so there is little pressure to drop it despite fax's long-term decline.
This feature sits close to the core fax service and is cheap to sustain, so it is unlikely to fall short enough of aspirations to trigger removal.
Sandbox threat protection strengthens the core email security offer as threats grow; the firm already removed the weaker sibling virus-scanning product, suggesting this one is the retained solution.
